rivals-dolphin.title: Incognito Dolphin costume reveal
rivals-dolphin.alt: An illustrated blue shark grins from the mouth of a pink dolphin suit on the official Incognito Dolphin poster.
rivals-dolphin.source: Marvel Rivals official account, pre-launch reveal of Jeff’s Incognito Dolphin costume.
rivals-dolphin.credit: Marvel / NetEase Games · official costume reveal
rivals-dolphin.purpose: The poster preserves both faces and names the comic appearance, connecting the costume for sale to a joke readers could already recognize.

rivals-wheel.title: Hero gallery concept
rivals-wheel.alt: Development concept for Hulk’s hero gallery, with the roster arranged around a wheel.
rivals-wheel.source: NetEase Games, Art Vision Vol. 01. Frame published by Justin Wagner, PC Gamer.
rivals-wheel.purpose: Examines the space given to the featured hero in an early radial layout.

rivals-gallery.title: Heroes gallery
rivals-gallery.alt: The Heroes gallery organizes selectable characters in a grid of illustrated portrait cards.
rivals-gallery.source: Interface In Game, Heroes. The archive names no individual capture author.
rivals-gallery.sourceDate: Archive of the December 2024 release. Capture date unspecified.
rivals-gallery.credit: Marvel / NetEase Games · Interface In Game
rivals-gallery.purpose: Compares the shipped grid with the development wheel and pre-match arc.

rivals-selection.title: Pre-match hero selection
rivals-selection.alt: The pre-match screen has hero portraits along an arc at the right, an arena background, a 27-second countdown and six empty team slots.
rivals-selection.source: Interface In Game, Hero Selection. The archive names no individual capture author.
rivals-selection.sourceDate: Archive of the December 2024 release. Capture date unspecified.
rivals-selection.credit: Marvel / NetEase Games · Interface In Game
rivals-selection.purpose: Shows the curved selector surviving in the screen used to assemble a team.

rivals-van-dyne.title: Van Dyne’s anniversary offer
rivals-van-dyne.alt: Publisher illustration for the Van Dyne’s anniversary event featuring Psylocke’s Daring Daifuku costume.
rivals-van-dyne.source: Marvel Rivals team, December 4 update announcement, first event illustration.
rivals-van-dyne.purpose: Identifies the specific limited-time costume offer whose minimum and maximum outlay the chapter compares.

rivals-incursion.title: The Incursion battle pass
rivals-incursion.alt: Official illustration presenting The Incursion, the Season 11 costume pass.
rivals-incursion.source: Marvel Rivals team, Season 11 launch notes, battle-pass illustration.
rivals-incursion.purpose: Shows how the season presents costumes as a collection alongside a separately playable new hero.
